title: MTC CA Operator Disclosures Schema
description: Schema for MTC CA Operator disclosures supporting per-key and global disclosure URLs.

operator_name.description: Legal name of the MTC CA Operator.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when this manifest was last updated.

global_disclosures.description: Operator-wide disclosures applicable across all CA Cosigner Keys.

ca_repository_url.description: URL to the CA Operator's public repository where items like policy documents, Subscriber agreements, and historical revisions reside.

legal_entity_and_ownership_url.description: URL detailing legal entity status, beneficial ownership, and corporate control.

status_and_incidents_url.description: URL to public operational status and incident reporting pages.

facility_certification_url.description: URL to ISO/IEC 27001 or equivalent facility audit certification.

ca_cosigner_keys.description: List of disclosures specific to each CA Cosigner Key operated by the CA.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable name for the CA Cosigner Key.

key_sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the CA Cosigner Key public key.

policy_documents_url.description: URL to the Markdown/AsciiDoc CPS for this specific key.

reserve_keys_url.description: URL disclosing anticipated Reserve CA Cosigner Keys for this key lineage.

key_generation_attestation_url.description: URL to the Key Generation Ceremony Attestation report for this key.

infrastructure_architecture_url.description: URL describing infrastructure architecture and geographic diversity for this key.

facility_certification_url.description: Optional override URL for facility certification if this key is hosted in a distinct facility.
